description: Returns a broadband coverage summary for a geography — population with zero, one, two, or three-plus providers at a given speed threshold, split by urban/rural and tribal/non-tribal segments. The primary tool for digital divide and equity analysis. Supports state, county, congressional district, census place, CBSA (metro area), tribal area, and national level. Data is from FCC Form 477 (as of June 2021), for historical population screening; it cannot establish current BEAD eligibility or address service.

geography_id.description: FIPS GEOID for the geography. State: 2-digit (e.g., "06" for California). County: 5-digit (e.g., "06037" for LA County). Congressional district: 4-digit state+district (e.g., "0601"). CBSA: 5-digit code. Place: 7-digit state+place (e.g., "0644000"). Omit for nation-level queries.

geography_type.description: Geographic aggregation level. "nation" = US-wide totals (geography_id not needed). "cd" = congressional district. "place" = census-designated place. "cbsa" = core-based statistical area (metro area). "tribal" = tribal land area.

speed_down.description: Download key for a download/upload threshold pair in Mbps: 0.2=0.2/0.2, 4=4/1, 10=10/1, 25=25/3, 100=100/10, 250=250/25, 1000=1000/100. These historical population aggregates cannot establish current BEAD eligibility or address service; 100/10 does not establish 100/20 availability.

tech_filter.description: Any nonempty alphabetical combination of a=ADSL/DSL, c=cable, f=fiber, o=other (symmetric DSL, other copper, power line), s=satellite, w=fixed wireless. Default acfow excludes satellite; explicit acfosw includes every technology. acfow includes all fixed wireless and is not an exact program-technology eligibility filter.

tribal_filter.description: Filter to tribal ("T") or non-tribal ("N") areas. Use "T" to assess Native American connectivity gaps.

urban_rural_filter.description: Filter to urban ("U") or rural ("R") areas only, or "all" for both combined. An empty segment in a confirmed geography returns zero population with a notice.

name: fcc_get_coverage_summary

geographyId.description: FIPS GEOID queried. Absent for nation-level.

breakdown.description: Per-segment breakdown by urban/rural and tribal/non-tribal.

population.description: Population breakdown for this urban/rural × tribal segment.

noCoverage.description: Population with no coverage in this segment.

oneProvider.description: Population with one provider in this segment.

threeOrMore.description: Population with three or more providers in this segment.

twoProviders.description: Population with two providers in this segment.

competitivePct.description: Percentage with two or more providers.

coveragePct.description: Percentage of population with at least one provider at the given speed.

dataVintage.description: Data vintage — Form 477 data as of June 2021.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `coverage_timeout`: Required coverage reads exceed the shared 48 second deadline. `geography_not_found`: No Area Table rows exist for the geography at the requested technology and speed, including the unfiltered confirmation of an empty demographic selection. `invalid_geography_combo`: geography_id is omitted for a non-nation type, or geography_type is "nation" but geography_id is provided. `invalid_geography_id_shape`: geography_id digit count does not match the geography_type (state=2, county=5, cd=4, cbsa=5, place=7). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

id.description: FIPS GEOID (e.g., "06"), or "0" for United States national coverage.

notice.description: Explains an empty requested population segment after confirming geography rows exist.

population.description: Population counts by provider availability tier.

noCoverage.description: Population where zero providers offer service at the given speed.

oneProvider.description: Population with exactly one provider — no competitive choice.

threeOrMore.description: Population with three or more providers.

speedDownMbps.description: Download speed threshold used in Mbps.

unservedPct.description: Percentage with zero providers in the selected historical technology and speed view.
